== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for Imperial Squad Leader, 2017 edition, for [[Imperial Squad Leader (PC Errata 2017 slip)]].

Source: [http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf DErrata.pdf] (“Official text as of March 1, 2017”, PDF made 31 May 2017), page 3; archived copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705005900/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf 20170705005900] (5 July 2017). Cut unchanged from a 300 dpi render of that page (pdftoppm -r 300). The June 2017 edition prints the same slip.

SHA-1 <code>1eab058f9c447d0003c103e6af870ced9abe1a30</code>, SHA-256 <code>d851f72827fb80cce59aa194d4da3e14769a314371d285acafb3266d7b43bc99</code>.
